FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
HomeTech Appliances & Repair specializes in the retail sale and repair of a wide range of household appliances, including refrigerators, washers, dryers, and ovens. Our operations are primarily conducted from our secure storefront located at 123 Appliance Ave, where we maintain an organized inventory. Less than 25% of our operations involve off-site activities such as delivery and emergency repairs, ensuring we manage our exposure effectively. Our staff is trained in manufacturer installation protocols to minimize installation errors and adhere to safety standards. We also provide customers with high-quality after-sales support, ensuring any appliance issues are promptly resolved. We pride ourselves on maintaining a clean safety record, with no significant claims related to installation or property damage in the past five years. Our commitment to operational excellence is reflected in our adherence to all local regulations and safety codes.

Our business specializes in appliance sales and repair, where we regularly conduct installation and emergency repairs at our customers' locations to ensure their appliances function optimally.
